software.name: mysql
software.summary: Open source relational database management system

packages.name: mysql
packages.title: mysql
packages.description: Open source relational database management system

sourceDetails.caveats:
A "/etc/my.cnf" or "/etc/mysql/my.cnf" from another install may interfere
with a Homebrew-built server starting up correctly.

Upgrading from MySQL <8.4 to MySQL >9.0 requires running MySQL 8.4 first:
 - brew services stop mysql
 - brew install mysql@8.4
 - brew services start mysql@8.4
 - brew services stop mysql@8.4
 - brew services start mysql

We've installed your MySQL database without a root password. To secure it run:
    mysql_secure_installation

MySQL is configured to only allow connections from localhost by default

To connect run:
    mysql -u root
